changes: Added explicit offline recovery-runner scenario profiles: list and weighted parsing, fail-closed CLI validation, unique weighted record identities, selfchecks, and docs boundary updates.
usage: Run node experiments/recovery-runner/run-driver.mjs --scenarioProfile weighted --scenarioParams B1:2,B2:1 --tasks foo --seed fixed --k 1 for an exploratory offline profile.
expectedOutcome: The user sees an explicit profile line such as scenario profile weighted: B1,B1,B2, fixed B1-B15 remains the default without profile flags, and invalid profile input exits 2 before sidecars.
actualTranscript: run-driver-selfcheck reported 167 assertions passed; focused weighted CLI printed scenario profile weighted: B1,B1,B2 and no-engine refusal; dangling --scenarioProfile exited 2 with no sidecars; lattice validate passed 31/31 commands and 13/13 verification intents.
outcomeDiff: Expected and actual matched. One review-discovered fail-open bug for dangling --scenarioProfile was fixed and re-reviewed before TEST.
limitations: This is an exploratory offline recovery-runner harness feature only; it is not lifecycle gate evidence, production readiness proof, or a replacement for fixed B1-B15 pre-registered protocol.
pitfalls: Do not interpret weighted profile output as production or DONE assurance; use explicit --scenarioProfile with valid --scenarioParams and keep default fixed protocol for pre-registered results.
